title: Tetsunabe no Jan! R: Choujou Sakusen

titleNative: 鉄鍋のジャン!R 頂上作戦
synopsis: This year in major international competition of Chinese cuisine, the presumed winners are assured of victory. Indeed, a major sponsor is behind them. These are the ultra-powerful and ultra-wealthy 13 dragons, mostly linked to the Mafia. About this competition which is of prime importance, they control the judges, and put pressure on some competitors worrisome. However it was not counting on the arrival of a cook who fears no pressure. Known in the culinary world for his pranks and his eccentricity, he was once involved in the murder by poisoning. After disappearing for years in China, where nobody knew what he was doing, Jan is back!

title: Tama Torarechattayoooo
titleNative: タマとられちゃったよおおおぉ
synopsis: The grim city of Oosaka is controlled by the Yakuza. On the secluded artificial island of Sakishima, there exists a rumour: There is a "wolf" out hunting the Yakuza. This wolf would use a demon sword to slay the Yakuza's dignity. That is, this sword has the ability to turn them into little girls!!!! A tale of the high-school student who hunts Yakuza and the former-Yakuza girl! These pretend-siblings with a bond too strong will face the Yakuza infesting Oosaka. title: Kawaihara Senpai wa Kawaii (Saotome-kun) ga Suki!
titleRomaji: Kawaihara Senpai wa Kawaii (Saotome-kun) ga Suki!
titleNative: 可愛原先輩はかわいい（早乙女くん）がすき！
synopsis: Saotome is a short boy who's not very good at sports. He thought that he would at least be able to get good grades, but starting high school, he is far from the top rank, and he feels depressed because he has nothing else to offer. He is consoled by Kawaihara-senpai, the beautiful student council president who is like a "perfect girl" that excels in sports and academics. She tells him that she has been at the top of her class since the entrance examination, and she offers to help Saotome study. However, as a condition for her help, she wants him to wear a girl's sailor suit uniform when studying with her… After school, a secret study session begins. (Source: Natalie, translated)
